title: Monotonicity of the logarithmic bound
statement: If $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$ and $a\le b$, then $\ell(a)\le\ell(b)$, where $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ for positive $n$ and $\ell(0)=1$.
